source.title: Call for Applicants - WFC Members (September 2022)
source.content:
The WCA Financial Committee (WFC) is looking for a few new members to add to its team. The applications are open to everyone; it is not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WFC do?

* Day-to-day bookkeeping using Xero, managing the finances and cash flow of the WCA.
* Determine the annual budget for the WCA and forecasting, including analysis and projections of competitor counts.
* Manage the Dues system including invoicing and credit control.
* Complete tax and other regulatory compliance forms on behalf of the WCA.
* Review applications for funding in accordance with the Equipment Funding and Travel Reimbursement policies.
* Other financial tasks requested by the WCA Board or in accordance with our Motions.

The official rights and duties of the WFC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2021.6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.6%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf).

<!-- break -->

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

* Good math or data analytics skills.
* Good written English.
* Time commitment of 2-5 hours per week.
* Prompt review and response to committee emails.

The following are not required, but it would be useful for new WFC members to have experience with any of the following:

* Experience in finance, tax, or accounting.
* Experience using spreadsheets and familiarity with Google G-Suite.
* Knowledge and experience in non-profit or corporate finances.
* US tax and IRS knowledge.

Candidacy documents must include:

* A brief cover letter and personal introduction, including your motivation for applying to the WFC.
* A WCA resume listing your involvement with the cubing community so far.
* Your professional resume (especially if math/accounting/finance related).

You can expect an immediate reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WFC Leader.

Please submit your application by **Tuesday, 11 October, 2022 at 23:59 UTC** to the WCA Treasurer and Leader of the WCA Financial Committee, James Molloy (jmolloy@worldcubeassociation.org). Applications will be reviewed by the WFC Leader and Senior Members. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate in reaching out first before sending your application.

Thank you for your interest in joining the WFC, and we look forward to receiving your applications!

translation.title: 招募 WCA 财务委员会成员（2022 年 9 月）
translation.content:
WCA 财务委员会（WFC）计划招募几位新成员。所有人都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。

WFC 负责什么？

* 使用 Xero 处理日常记账，管理 WCA 的财务与现金流。
* 制定 WCA 年度预算及财务预测，包括参赛人数的分析和预测。
* 管理会费制度，包括开具账单及应收款管理。
* 代表 WCA 完成税务和其他监管合规表格。
* 依据《器材资助政策》和《差旅报销政策》审核资助申请。
* 完成 WCA 董事会要求的，或议案规定的其他财务工作。

WFC 的正式权利与职责载于 [WCA 议案 10.2021.6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.6%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf)。

我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

* 良好的数学或数据分析能力。
* 良好的英语书面表达能力。
* 每周可投入 2–5 小时。
* 能及时查看和回复委员会邮件。

以下经验并非必需，但会对 WFC 的工作有所帮助：

* 财务、税务或会计经验。
* 使用电子表格的经验，并熟悉 Google G-Suite。
* 非营利组织或企业财务方面的知识和经验。
* 了解美国税务及美国国税局（IRS）相关事务。

申请材料须包含：

* 简短的申请信和个人介绍，包括申请加入 WFC 的原因。
* 一份 WCA 经历简历，列出截至目前参与魔方社区的情况。
* 职业简历，尤其是数学、会计或财务相关经历。

我们会及时回复，确认材料是否完整，也可能邀请你与 WFC 负责人面试。

请于 **2022 年 10 月 11 日星期二 23:59 UTC** 前，将申请提交给 WCA 财务主管兼财务委员会负责人 James Molloy（jmolloy@worldcubeassociation.org）。申请将由 WFC 负责人及高级成员审核。如有疑问，欢迎在提交申请前先联系我们。

感谢你愿意加入 WFC，期待收到你的申请！
